# Total Federal Securities Outstanding = Public debt securities + Agency securities
# From Table FFO-1, "Selected balances, end of period" columns (18) Public debt + (19) Agency
# FY1980 months Feb-June 1980:
# Feb: 854591 + 7011 = 861602
# Mar: 863451 + 6993 = 870444
# Apr: 870009 + 6905 = 876914
# May: 877917 + 6871 = 884788
# Jun: 877614 + 6768 = 884382
total = {
    "Feb": 854591 + 7011,
    "Mar": 863451 + 6993,
    "Apr": 870009 + 6905,
    "May": 877917 + 6871,
    "Jun": 877614 + 6768,
}

# BLS CPI-U (1982-84=100), not seasonally adjusted, monthly 1980 (best-known historical values):
# Feb 1980 = 78.0, Mar = 80.1, Apr = 81.0, May = 81.8, Jun = 82.7
cpi = {
    "Feb": 78.0,
    "Mar": 80.1,
    "Apr": 81.0,
    "May": 81.8,
    "Jun": 82.7,
}

# Normalize nominal totals to base Feb=100 (index relative to Feb value)
base_value = total["Feb"]
base_cpi = cpi["Feb"]

# Inflation-adjusted (real) value, expressed in Feb dollars, then normalized so Feb=100
adjusted = {}
for m in total:
    real_value = total[m] * (base_cpi / cpi[m])   # deflate to Feb base CPI
    adjusted[m] = real_value / base_value * 100.0  # normalize Feb=100

avg = sum(adjusted.values()) / len(adjusted)
print(round(avg, 2))
